## EM3 pilot

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(emmeans)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)
library(BayesFactor)
```

```{r}
list_of_files <- setdiff(dir(pattern=".csv"), "sub-1709_ses-1_20260519_093203.csv")

data <- read_delim(list_of_files)
```

Pre-processing

```{r}

df <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(agency_rating), block != 0) %>%
  mutate(
    # collapse conditions into social vs non-social
    social_context = case_when(
      condition %in% c("social", "ai_social") ~ "social",
      condition %in% c("nonsocial", "ai_nonsocial") ~ "non-social"
    ),
    social_context = factor(social_context),
    
    ai_context = case_when(
      condition %in% c("ai_nonsocial", "ai_social") ~ "ai",
      condition %in% c("nonsocial", "social") ~ "non-ai"
    ),
    social_context = factor(social_context),
    
    # z-score outcome
    outcome_z = as.numeric(scale(points_lost))
  )

df_social <- df %>% 
  filter(condition %in% c("social", "ai_social"))

df_nonsocial <- df %>% 
  filter(condition %in% c("nonsocial", "ai_nonsocial"))

df_ai <- df %>%
  filter(condition %in% c("ai_social", "ai_nonsocial"))

df_nonai <- df %>%
  filter(condition %in% c("social", "nonsocial"))

df_analysis <- df %>% 
  filter(balloon_pop != 1, coplayer_acted != 1)


```

Error rates

```{r}

pops <- df %>% filter(balloon_pop == 1)
coplayer_acted <- df %>% filter(coplayer_acted == 1)

# calculate percentage
pop_rate <- nrow(pops) / nrow(df) * 100
coplayer_acted_rate <- nrow(coplayer_acted) / nrow(df_social) * 100

```

Mean agency ratings

```{r}

df_analysis$condition <- factor(
  df_analysis$condition,
  levels = c(
    "nonsocial",
    "social",
    "ai_nonsocial",
    "ai_social"
  )
)

df_summary <- df_analysis %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_agency = mean(agency_rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(agency_rating, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )

df_summary_social <- df_analysis %>%
  group_by(social_context) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_agency = mean(agency_rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(agency_rating, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )


df_summary_ai <- df_analysis %>%
  group_by(ai_context) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_agency = mean(agency_rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(agency_rating, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )

summary_pops <- pops %>%
  summarise(
    mean_agency = mean(agency_rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(agency_rating, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )

summary_coplayer_acted <- coplayer_acted %>%
  summarise(
    mean_agency = mean(agency_rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(agency_rating, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )


# plot
ggplot(df_summary, aes(x = condition, y = mean_agency, fill = condition)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_agency - se,
                    ymax = mean_agency + se),
                width = 0.2) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 9)) +
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(
      c("ai_nonsocial", "nonsocial"),
      c("ai_social", "nonsocial")
    ),
    annotations = c("*", "*"),
    y_position = c(9, 8.5),
    tip_length = 0.05
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "social" = "#FA5252",
    "ai_nonsocial" = "#74C0FC",
    "ai_social" = "#C77DCE",
    "nonsocial" = "#ADB5BD"
  )) +
  labs(
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Mean agency rating"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
  panel.grid = element_blank()
  )


ggplot(df_summary_social, aes(x = social_context, y = mean_agency)) +
  geom_col(fill = "blue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_agency - se,
                    ymax = mean_agency + se),
                width = 0.2) +
  labs(
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Mean agency rating"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(df_summary_ai, aes(x = ai_context, y = mean_agency)) +
  geom_col(fill = "blue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_agency - se,
                    ymax = mean_agency + se),
                width = 0.2) +
  labs(
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Mean agency rating"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```

```{r}

model <- lmer(
  agency_rating ~ condition + outcome_z + (1 | participant),
  data = df_analysis
)

summary(model)

emmeans(model, pairwise ~ condition)

plot(emmeans(model, ~ condition))

plot(allEffects(model))


```

```{r}

model2 <- lmer(
  agency_rating ~ social_context * ai_context + (1 | participant),
  data = df_analysis
)

summary(model2)

emmeans(model2, pairwise ~ social_context * ai_context)

plot(emmeans(model2, ~ social_context + ai_context))

emmip(model2, social_context ~ ai_context)

plot(allEffects(model2))

```
